fullPassage: People seem to recognize that the arts are cultural activities that draw on (or react against) certain cultural traditions, certain shared understanding, and certain values and ideas that are characteristic of the time and place in which the art is created. In the case of science, however, opinions differ. Some scientists, like the great biologist J. B. S. Haldane, see science in a similar light — as a historical activity that occurs in a particular time and place, and that needs to be understood within that context. Others, however, see science as a purely "objective" pursuit, uninfluenced by the cultural viewpoint and values of those who create it. In describing this view of science, philosopher Hugh Lacey speaks of the belief that there is an underlying order of the world which is simply there to be discovered — the world of pure "fact" stripped of any link with value. The aim of science according to this view is to represent this world of pure "fact", independently of any relationship it might bear contingently to human practices and experiences.

✅ ④ ordinary(평범한): great(위대한, 뛰어난)의 반의어로 가장 적절 ←정답
det.tip: great(위대한) ↔ ordinary(평범한). famous(유명한)는 동의어이니 혼동 주의.

questions.passage:
(A) A good teacher can <u>draw</u> important lessons from even the smallest everyday events.

(B) The little boy sat down to <u>draw</u> a picture of his house with colored pencils.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 draw의 의미가 가장 가까운 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A)의 draw는 '끌어내다(이끌어내다)', (B)의 draw는 '(그림을) 그리다'라는 뜻입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 끌어내다 — 그리다: (A)는 작은 사건에서 교훈을 '끌어내다', (B)는 색연필로 그림을 '그리다' ←정답
❌ ② 그리다 — 끌어내다: (A)와 (B)의 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ 당기다 — 그리다: (A)의 draw는 '당기다'라는 물리적 의미가 아님
❌ ④ 끌어내다 — 당기다: (B)의 draw는 '당기다'가 아니라 '그리다'
det.tip: draw는 다의어입니다: ① (~에서) 끌어내다 ② (그림을) 그리다 ③ 당기다. 문맥으로 구분하세요.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the situation and information that surround something and help you to understand it"

det.korean: 어떤 것을 둘러싸고 이해를 돕는 상황과 정보를 뜻합니다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① method(방법): 일을 하는 방식이라 정의와 다름
❌ ② reason(이유): 까닭을 뜻해 정의와 다름
✅ ③ context(맥락): 어떤 것을 둘러싸고 이해를 돕는 상황·정보라는 정의에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ purpose(목적): 이루려는 목표라 정의와 다름
det.tip: context(맥락): needs to be understood within that context(그 맥락 안에서 이해되어야 한다).

questions.passage: In __________ (describe) this view of science, philosopher Hugh Lacey speaks of the belief that there is an underlying order of the world.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: 이러한 과학관을 설명하면서, 철학자 Hugh Lacey는 ~라는 믿음을 말한다.
det.analysis: 전치사 In(~하는 중에, ~하면서) 뒤에는 동사가 그대로 올 수 없고 동명사(-ing) 형태가 와야 해요. 그래서 describe를 describing(설명하면서)으로 바꿉니다. '전치사 + 동명사(-ing)'는 자주 쓰이는 형태예요.
det.tip: In describing = ~을 설명하면서. 전치사 뒤에는 동명사(-ing).

questions.passage: The aim of science according to this view is to represent this world of pure "fact", __________ (independent) of any relationship it might bear contingently to human practices and experiences.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: 이 관점에 따르면 과학의 목표는 순수한 사실의 세계를, 인간 경험과 맺을 수 있는 어떤 관계와도 독립적으로 표현하는 것이다.
det.analysis: 동사구 to represent(표현하다)를 꾸며 '독립적으로'라는 뜻을 더하려면 부사가 필요해요. 그래서 형용사 independent(독립적인)를 부사 independently(독립적으로)로 바꿉니다. 형용사를 부사로 만들 때는 보통 끝에 -ly를 붙여요.
det.tip: independent(형용사) → independently(부사). 동사를 꾸미므로 부사형이 옵니다.

questions.passage: People seem to recognize that the arts are cultural activities that draw on (or react against) certain cultural traditions, certain shared understanding, and certain values and ideas that are characteristic of the time and place in which the art is created. In the case of science, however, opinions differ. Some scientists, like the great biologist J. B. S. Haldane, see science in a similar light — as a historical activity that occurs in a particular time and place, and that needs to be understood __________. Others, however, see science as a purely "objective" pursuit, uninfluenced by the cultural viewpoint and values of those who create it. In describing this view of science, philosopher Hugh Lacey speaks of the belief that there is an underlying order of the world which is simply there to be discovered — the world of pure "fact" stripped of any link with value. The aim of science according to this view is to represent this world of pure "fact", independently of any relationship it might bear contingently to human practices and experiences.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 과학은 특정한 시간·장소에서 일어나며 '그 맥락 안에서(within that context)' 이해되어야 한다
det.analysis:
✅ ① within that context(그 맥락 안에서): 과학을 그 시대·장소의 맥락 속에서 이해해야 한다는 흐름에 적절 ←정답
❌ ② beyond that limit(그 한계를 넘어서): 문맥과 어긋남
❌ ③ against that rule(그 규칙에 반하여): 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ before that time(그 시간 이전에): 문맥과 무관
det.tip: needs to be understood within that context(그 맥락 안에서 이해되어야 한다).

questions.passage: People seem to recognize that the arts are cultural activities that draw on (or react against) certain cultural traditions, certain shared understanding, and certain values and ideas that are characteristic of the time and place in which the art is created. In __________, however, opinions differ. Some scientists, like the great biologist J. B. S. Haldane, see science in a similar light — as a historical activity that occurs in a particular time and place, and that needs to be understood within that context. Others, however, see science as a purely "objective" pursuit, uninfluenced by the cultural viewpoint and values of those who create it. In describing this view of science, philosopher Hugh Lacey speaks of the belief that there is an underlying order of the world which is simply there to be discovered — the world of pure "fact" stripped of any link with value. The aim of science according to this view is to represent this world of pure "fact", independently of any relationship it might bear contingently to human practices and experiences.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그러나 '과학의 경우에는(the case of science)' 의견이 갈린다
det.analysis:
❌ ① the world of value(가치의 세계): 앞 문장(예술)에서 과학으로 넘어가는 전환에 맞지 않음
❌ ② the study of art(예술 연구): 앞에서 이미 다룬 예술이라 흐름과 어긋남
❌ ③ the field of history(역사 분야): 문맥과 무관
✅ ④ the case of science(과학의 경우): 예술을 말한 뒤 과학으로 화제를 옮기는 전환 표현으로 적절 ←정답
det.tip: In the case of science, however, opinions differ(그러나 과학의 경우에는 의견이 갈린다).
